concerns.text: T017 (McNemar's test) and T019b (benchmark_results.csv generation) are marked incomplete. These tasks are the sole implementation for FR-005 (McNemar's test) and SC-003 (p-value measurement). Without these, the spec's requirement to determine statistical significance is unfulfilled.

T030a (sensitivity analysis) is incomplete. This is the sole task covering the 'Threshold Justification' assumption and SC-005 (85% threshold verification). The plan explicitly states this analysis is required to validate the success condition; its absence leaves the project's success criteria untestable.

T026 (acceptance_checker.py) is incomplete. This task is the only mechanism to verify that all User Stories (US-1, US-2, US-3) and Acceptance Scenarios are met end-to-end. Its absence means the plan lacks a formal verification step for the Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and the final success verdict.

T028a and T028b (ConstraintSatisfactionError handling) are incomplete. These are the specific tasks addressing the 'insufficient constraints' edge case defined in the spec. While T012c has a generic catch-all, the spec requires explicit handling and logging for this specific error type to distinguish it from other failures (FR-007).

T031 (final_report_generator.py) is incomplete. This task is required to aggregate all research artifacts into the 'Single Source of Truth' final deliver (Constitution Principle IV). Without it, the project lacks the mandated final report structure.
